mentions.name: re-goldsrc-won-launcher-1792
mentions.description: A reverse-engineered reconstruction of the original 1990s WON-era Half-Life launcher, restoring the original look and properties of the code. LLMs were used extensively to reverse the code for the first time, and the resulting code is publicly available.
mentions.source_excerpt: Last month I've finished the reverse-engineering of the original WON-era Half-Life launcher from 90s (https://github.com/oxiKKK/re-goldsrc-won-launcher-1792).
